body: Whether you’re preparing a property, moving to a new address, or need space for belongings in between, Laurrel Services helps you arrange the work in one place.

supportCard.body: Tell us what you need and your preferred date.

headline: The details matter before the work begins.
introParagraph: Cleaning a property, moving belongings and arranging storage are different jobs, each with its own requirements. At Laurrel Services, these three services are the focus of our work in Ottawa.

services.title: Cleaning
services.description: From the condition of a property to the areas that need attention, a cleaning job starts with understanding the space and the work involved.

services.title: Moving
services.description: A moving plan depends on what needs transporting, where it's going, building access and the time available to complete the job.

services.title: Storage
services.description: The amount being stored, the length of time and access requirements are important considerations when arranging storage.

headline: A space to clean. A move to make. Belongings to store.

services.title: Cleaning
services.description: An apartment after move-out. A home that needs a thorough clean. A workplace being prepared for its next day of business. Tell us about the space, what needs attention and when you'd like it done.

services.title: Moving
services.description: A new address comes with its own logistics. Furniture, boxes, stairs, elevators and moving dates all need consideration. Tell us what you're moving and where it needs to go.

services.title: Storage
services.description: Between leases, renovating or simply making more room? Let us know what you're keeping, how much space you expect to need and how long you plan to store it.

headline: When one job depends on another.
intro:
A final clean may have to wait until the furniture is moved. New keys may arrive days after your move-out date. Renovations can leave you short of space.

Tell us what needs doing and how your dates line up.

situations.title: Before you hand back the keys
situations.description: Once the furniture is out, there may still be cleaning to finish before the final inspection. Tell us about the property, the areas needing attention and your handover date.

details.intro: Once the furniture is moved out, a thorough clean ensures the space is inspected and handed over on schedule.
considerations: Number of rooms and deep-cleaning requirements
Moving truck departure timing and empty room access

situations.title: When moving dates don't match
situations.description: Moving out on Friday but getting your new keys on Monday? Tell us about your belongings and both dates so we can discuss the moving and storage arrangements available.

details.intro: A transitional gap between addresses requires a secure holding arrangement and coordinated transport.
considerations: Move-out date and new possession date
Volume of boxed belongings and large furniture pieces
Access requirements during the transitional gap period

situations.title: While your property is being renovated
situations.description: Furniture may need to be moved out of the way before work begins. Once the work is finished, there may also be cleaning to arrange. Tell us which parts of the job you need.

details.intro: Renovations need clear work areas. Protect furniture with temporary storage and arrange post-work fine-dust cleaning.
considerations: Post-renovation fine-dust cleaning and furniture reinstatement timing

aboutCompany.headline: Cleaning, moving and storage. All in one place.
aboutCompany.paragraph1: There's the furniture to transport, the property to clean before the keys go back, and sometimes a few days when everything needs somewhere to stay. Each job has its own timing and requirements.
aboutCompany.paragraph2: Laurrel Services offers cleaning, moving and storage in Ottawa. You can request one service on its own or tell us about several related jobs. We start with the details of what you need, where and when.

emphasisPoints.text: Book the service your property or move requires.
Discuss multiple service needs in the same enquiry.

whatWeDo.headline: There's more than one way to get a space ready.
whatWeDo.intro: Not every job starts with a move. Sometimes it's a property that needs cleaning, furniture that needs relocating or belongings that need somewhere to stay. Laurrel Services offers all three, so you can start with the work that matters to you.

columns.description: Whether a property is occupied or being prepared for its next use, tell us about the rooms, their condition and the cleaning work you have in mind.
Changing addresses involves more than transporting boxes. The belongings, access at each property and preferred date all matter when planning a move.
Between properties, renovating or making extra room? Tell us what needs storing and how long you expect to need the space.

whyLaurrel.headline: Different needs. One place to start.
whyLaurrel.intro: Cleaning, moving and storage each require different arrangements. Knowing what’s involved helps you make better decisions before confirming a service.

items.title: One enquiry for related jobs
items.description: If your plans involve cleaning, moving and storage, include everything in the same request. The requirements can then be reviewed together.

items.title: Details before decisions
items.description: The property, belongings, access conditions and dates all matter. Understanding these details is the starting point for discussing a service.

items.title: One service is fine too
items.description: You can enquire about cleaning, moving or storage independently. There's no need to request more than the job requires.

items.title: Plan around your dates
items.description: Moving dates, property handovers and renovations can involve different deadlines. Include your preferred dates when making an enquiry.

faq.headline: A few things worth knowing before you book.
faq.intro: A few practical answers about arranging cleaning, moving and storage with Laurrel Services.

items.question: Can I request more than one service?
items.answer: Yes. If you need cleaning, moving or storage as part of the same job, describe the requirements in one enquiry. The arrangements and availability can then be reviewed.

items.question: What should I include in a cleaning request?
items.answer: Tell us about the property, its approximate size, the areas to be cleaned, its current condition and your preferred date.

items.question: What information is needed for a moving quote?
items.answer: Include your collection and delivery locations, preferred date, approximate inventory and any important access details, such as stairs, elevators or parking restrictions.

items.question: What should I tell you about my storage needs?
items.answer: Describe the belongings, approximate amount of space needed, how long you expect to store them and whether you’ll require access during that period.

items.question: Does Laurrel serve locations outside Ottawa?
items.answer: Include your location or postal code in your enquiry. Service availability can then be confirmed for your area.

finalCta.headline: Tell us what you need done.
finalCta.body: Cleaning, moving or storage in Ottawa? Share a few details about the job and your preferred date.

seo.metaTitle: About Laurrel Services | Cleaning, Moving & Storage in Ottawa
seo.metaDescription: Learn about Laurrel Services and our cleaning, moving and storage services in Ottawa. Understand our approach to planning related service requests.

articleIntro.h2: Cleaning, moving and storage services in Ottawa
articleIntro.paragraph1: Getting a property ready, moving to a new address or finding room for belongings can involve different arrangements. Laurrel Services offers cleaning, moving and storage in Ottawa, with each request considered according to the work involved.
articleIntro.paragraph2: Whether you need one service or several, start by telling us what needs doing, where and when. We'll use those details to discuss the available arrangements.

services.title: Cleaning Services in Ottawa
services.headline: Cleaning for homes and properties in Ottawa
paragraphs: An occupied home doesn't need the same attention as an empty property being prepared for its next occupants. A workplace has its own requirements, too. Before any cleaning job can be planned properly, it helps to understand the space and what needs attention.
Laurrel Services welcomes cleaning enquiries from Ottawa customers. Tell us about the property, the rooms or areas involved, its current condition and the date you have in mind.
services.planningTitle: What to include in your cleaning enquiry
services.planningIntro: Whether you're preparing to move in, getting ready to hand back the keys or arranging cleaning for a property in regular use, the details help establish the scope. Useful information includes:
usefulInfo: The type and approximate size of the property
Whether the space is occupied or empty
The rooms and surfaces requiring attention
Your preferred date and access arrangements

services.title: Moving Services in Ottawa
services.headline: Moving services in Ottawa
paragraphs: Moving across Ottawa can involve more than the distance between two addresses. A condo may have an elevator reservation. An apartment may have narrow stairs. Large furniture may need particular attention, and collection or delivery times may depend on building access.
Laurrel Services handles moving enquiries in Ottawa. Start by telling us where the belongings are coming from, where they’re going and what needs transporting.
services.planningIntro: You don't need to have every detail worked out before getting in touch. An approximate inventory and a preferred moving date are a useful starting point. Information to include:
usefulInfo: Approximate number and type of belongings
services.extraNote: If you also need cleaning or storage, mention that in the same enquiry.

services.title: Storage Services in Ottawa
services.headline: Storage services in Ottawa
paragraphs: Your lease may end before the next one begins. Renovations may require furniture to be moved out temporarily. Or you may simply need to make room for belongings you aren’t ready to part with.
Storage requirements vary. A few packed boxes are different from the contents of an entire home, and the length of time matters just as much as the amount of space.
Laurrel Services accepts storage enquiries in Ottawa. Describe what you need to keep, approximately how much space it will require and how long you expect to need storage.
services.planningIntro: There are several details worth confirming:
usefulInfo: What items need to be stored
Whether you’ll need access to the items
When the belongings need to go into storage
Any particular handling or storage requirements
services.extraNote: The available storage arrangement, access conditions, location and applicable terms should be confirmed before booking.

gettingStarted.headline: Tell us about the job. Start with the essentials.

steps.title: Describe what you need
steps.description: Choose Cleaning, Moving, Storage or a combination. Include the property or belongings involved and any important requirements.

steps.title: Share your location and preferred date
steps.description: Tell us where the work is needed and when you would like it arranged. For moving requests, include both the collection and delivery locations.

steps.title: Request availability and a quote
steps.description: Submit your enquiry so the service requirements and available arrangements can be confirmed before booking.

items.question: Can I enquire about cleaning, moving and storage together?
items.answer: Yes. Describe the different requirements in one enquiry. For example, you might need belongings moved, a property cleaned and storage between two moving dates. Availability and arrangements will need to be confirmed.

items.question: What should I include when requesting a cleaning quote?
items.answer: Start with the type and approximate size of the property, its current condition, the areas needing attention and your preferred date. Include any special requirements that could affect the scope.

items.question: What affects the planning of a move?
items.answer: The belongings being transported, collection and destination locations, stairs, elevators, loading access and preferred date are all relevant. Larger items and building restrictions are worth identifying early.

items.question: How do I know how much storage space I need?
items.answer: Start with an inventory of the items you intend to store. Include approximate dimensions for larger furniture and the expected duration. The suitable arrangement and available space can then be discussed.

items.question: Do you provide services outside Ottawa?
items.answer: Include your location or postal code when enquiring. Laurrel can confirm whether the requested service is available at your address.

items.question: How much will my service cost?
items.answer: The price will depend on the service requested and the work involved. Share the relevant details so an appropriate quotation can be discussed. Any final price and terms should be confirmed before booking.

finalCta.headline: Tell us what needs doing.
finalCta.body: A cleaning job, a moving date or storage between addresses. Tell us about your plans and the service you need.
